messages:
Alice Nguyen: quick heads-up — during the RBAC rollout testing I noticed missing audit events for service role changes in Console and Gateway. see below for rough list.
Ben Ortiz: can you paste the exact actions/events you saw missing?
Alice Nguyen: yeah — specifically `role.assign` and `role.revoke` from Console UI flows; Gateway shows no `auth.token.exchange` on service-to-service calls when using JWT rotation.
Carol Kim: ugh. those are customer-facing audit items. which customers reported? any P0?
Alice Nguyen: no direct customer bug yet, found in automated evt-coverage test. but could surface during enterprise evidence requests.
Diego Ramos: where does KMS fit in here? we changed keys for token signing last week. might be related.
Alice Nguyen: possibly. Vault/KMS rotation changed the token header, the runtime omitted emitting `auth.key.rotate` to audit log in some code paths.
Eve Patel: tagging in compliance: @audit-bot please create ticket for "missing audit events: role changes, token exchange, key rotate" and add sev:medium.
audit-bot: Created INC-4282 and JIRA:SEC-1120 — added labels: audit-coverage, customer-evidence.
Ben Ortiz: thanks. Can we get a quick PoC to reproduce? attach curl or sample?
Alice Nguyen: repro steps (short):
```
# simulate console role assign
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/roles/assign \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" \
  -d '{"user_id":"u123","role":"billing_admin"}'
```
Result: UI succeeds, but no `role.assign` in audit stream.
Carol Kim: ok. priority = add audit emission in Console backend + Gateway token-exchange path. Who owns Console backend? @Diego?
Diego Ramos: yep i can take Console patch. I will add emission and unit test. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ben Ortiz: I'll take Gateway fix — looks like middleware dropped event on rotated keys.
Eve Patel: need to consider schema change too — customers expect `actor.service_id` and `actor_key.kms_key_id` for key rotations. We should propose minimal schema extension.
Alice Nguyen: proposed sample event for key rotation (draft):
```
{
  "event_type": "auth.key.rotate",
  "timestamp": "2024-11-01T15:22:00Z",
  "actor": { "type": "system", "service_id": "runtime-1" },
  "details": { "kms_key_id": "projects/prod/keys/rw-2024-12", "rotation_reason": "scheduled" }
}
```
Carol Kim: that looks fine. Add `request_id` and `correlation_id` so we can join traces.
Alice Nguyen: agreed — will update.
Diego Ramos: backlog plan suggestion:
- SEC-1120 (audit events missing) -> split by service: Console (SEC-1120-a), Gateway (SEC-1120-b), Runtime (SEC-1120-c), Billing (SEC-1120-d)
- quick patch for emission + unit tests (1 day each)
- schema proposal RFC for `auth.key.rotate` + `actor_key.kms_key_id` (owner: Carol)
Ben Ortiz: runtime also missing `billing.plan.apply` audit event when metering switch happens — saw it in logs. add to list.
Eve Patel: compliance ask: include linkability to customer org and data residency fields if event originates in non-us regions. not a blocker, but note for RFC.
Alice Nguyen: adding owners: Console->Diego, Gateway->Ben, Runtime->Ben, Billing->Carol.
Diego Ramos: I'll open PR for Console emission: #2467. cc @Alice Nguyen for test case.
Ben Ortiz: opening Gateway PR now, will include middleware patch and integration test using rotated keys. PR #2468.
Carol Kim: I'll draft RFC for schema changes and post to docs/ and security-rfc channel. aiming EOD Friday.
Eve Patel: once RFC posted, compliance will review and prepare customer communication template for audit evidence requests.
Alice Nguyen: thanks team. follow-ups: attach unit test results to SEC-1120 tickets, and let's do a quick 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 to confirm deploy windows. :thumbsup:
Ben Ortiz: ack.
Diego Ramos: ack.
Carol Kim: ack.
Eve Patel: ack.
[thread ended]
